title: Add TUI golden snapshot and redaction tests
purpose: Lock the operator-facing TUI views with deterministic snapshots and secret redaction checks.
scope: Add golden snapshots for dashboard, run detail, approval queue and recovery view.
Add redaction fixtures with secret-like values and secret handles.
Add deterministic ordering checks for runs, events and ecosystem artifacts.
Add tests that fail on raw secret leakage.
Keep snapshots line-oriented to avoid terminal library dependency churn.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot tests are stable across repeated local runs.
Secret-like payloads are redacted while handles remain explainable.
Approval and rollback states are visible in snapshots.
Test failures identify the view and leak category.
failure_modes: Snapshots require external terminal rendering state.
Secret redaction tests miss audit timeline output.
